observations: body L1-L2: «ut» (L1) and the final m of «lectionum» (L2) are printed heavier than the rest of the line; the H of «Heibergiani» is printed broken (like «ll»).
body (Ursa minor 3): the sign after «non 30» is printed low, like a comma; transcribed as printed.
body (Ursa maior 19): the period after «Vh» is printed faintly.
body (Hercules 11): the dash before «Magnitudo» is printed broken in two pieces.
body (Lyra 5, Cygnus 8): a speck is printed between «çagueras» and «que», and another before «8.»; not transcribed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
